title: Enforce rotating Shift Lead, cooldown, Jam and active-seat eligibility
prompt: Read README.md, AGENTS.md, docs/SWARM_PILOT.md, docs/PILOT100_BACKLOG.md and the frozen sources under docs/design/ first. RULES-SPEC-v1.md is the canonical six-node deterministic gameplay contract; completed foundation APIs remain compatibility history. Implement new versioned APIs without changing the completed T01–T10 contracts. Work only in declared ownership; no manifests, shared exports or dependencies unless explicitly owned. Engine production remains ES2022-only, pure and independent from Firebase, Node, browser, UI and Capacitor. Use original synthetic test data and injected authority time/entropy; no clocks or global randomness in engine. Never expose seed, roles, private inputs or raw audit data through public output. Do not invent a rule where an explicit design gap is named. Run scoped lint/typecheck/tests and npm run check; report contract changes and observed results. No commits, pushes, PRs, child agents, cloud deployment, credentials or budget changes. Implement pure eligibility/rotation helpers from Rules v1§3: Shift Lead advances in fixed seat order among active players; current Lead may vote/serve unless a status blocks it; previous Repair Crew is ineligible for the next Crew selection for one round; Jam blocks voting/Crew for one round; permanent game-Disconnected players are spectators. Track last-served round separately for tie breaking and clear next-round statuses at the correct boundary. Network reconnect cannot revive a game-Disconnected seat. If fewer than two eligible candidates remain, report the explicit unavailable pool without relaxing rules; continuation is tracked by D-ELIGIBLE-POOL.
acceptance: Seat rotation preserves original order and skips game-Disconnected spectators without electing a new Lead from votes.
Jam and Crew cooldown last exactly their specified next-round window, including overlap and subsequent clearance.
Eligibility never grants spectator voting/Crew authority and exposes insufficient candidate pools without inventing a bypass.
Scoped lint, typecheck and tests plus npm run check pass; legacy APIs retain compatibility and only owned files change.
